capabilities: Search and read notes in approved folders
Apply updates with backups and source-hash conflict checks
Pair ChatGPT through a pairing code
disambiguation: Not a bulk note rewriter; it connects ChatGPT to user-approved vault folders.
extras: Desktop-only; runs a loopback-only local bridge and can use an encrypted public relay hosted on Cloudflare with Auth0 authentication. No telemetry, ads or OpenAI API key; note deletion is intentionally unsupported.
problem: ChatGPT cannot reach a local Obsidian vault, and giving an AI open write access to notes risks unwanted or conflicting edits.

relations.evidence: connects the @Obsidian ChatGPT plugin to user-approved folders in a local Obsidian vault

summary: Bridge that lets ChatGPT's @Obsidian plugin search, read and update notes in approved vault folders, with previews, backups and conflict checks.
